connections.description: Hamilton was general counsel to Sen. Sessions on the Senate Judiciary Committee (2015 to January 2017) and then Counselor to the Attorney General at the Justice Department. His DOJ end date differs by source: ProPublica lists March 2019; his America First Legal biography says 2021.

summary: Gene Hamilton was general counsel to Sen. Jeff Sessions on the Judiciary Committee, then a Justice Department and Homeland Security official in Trump's first term. In 2021 he co-founded America First Legal with Stephen Miller, served as deputy White House counsel from January to June 2025, and returned to lead the group as president.
